Ongoing: each mission takes 30–90 min; each repeatable task 10–60 min

A set of missions and repeatable tasks in Rathleton and Oramond (also called Rathleton Tasks or Glooth Factory Quest). You help scientists, guards and citizens fight bandits, minotaurs, mutated glooth and other problems of the city. Each mission or task gives voting rights in the {wiki:Rathleton Magistrate|Rathleton Magistrate}, which you use to rank up in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest|Rathleton Quest}.
Terrence, Workshop Quarter of Rathleton (tasks without rank)
Each mission or task gives voting rights in the {wiki:Rathleton Magistrate|Rathleton Magistrate}: 50 for Commoner, 150 for Inhabitant, 300 for Citizen and 500 for Squire.
Necrometer from the Dark Trails Quest
After doing the **Probing** task from {npc:Doubleday}, {npc:Jondrin} will give you the {item:Necrometer}.
The {wiki:Dark Trails Quest|Dark Trails Quest} also asks for other tasks from this quest (for example The Ancient Sewers).
